_comment: Which folders a Compare & Sync looks at, and what it ignores. Edit this rather than the code - every list here is site-specific, and hard-coding them meant anyone with different software had to maintain a fork. Delete this file and the tool falls back to the same values built in.
_userFolders: Compared by default. The folders a person keeps their own work in.
_appDataFolders: Added only when 'Compare & Sync: include AppData' is on. Roaming only - AppData\Local is machine-specific by definition.
_excludeDirs: Never compared, at any scope. Caches and per-install state that differ on every machine and are wanted on none.
_excludeFiles: Never copied. NTUSER.DAT and UsrClass.dat are registry hives - copying one over a working profile destroys it, so they are not negotiable. The rest are working files no one would choose to carry forward.
_rootFolderNoise: Folders on the root of C: that Windows puts there. Anything NOT in this list is reported by the program comparison as possibly holding software data.
